description: Approved flow features computed solely from packets in the monitored direction. Legacy bidirectional CICFlowMeter flow-wide features are not accepted.

excluded_legacy_features.name: Flow Duration
excluded_legacy_features.reason: Classic CICFlowMeter Flow Duration spans the complete bidirectional flow and is classified responder-dependent in the master mapping.

excluded_legacy_features.name: FIN Flag Count
excluded_legacy_features.reason: Aggregate TCP flag count can include reverse/responder packets.

limitations: This contract does not by itself prove that a capture is direction-verified. Trusted sensor/topology provenance is required.
Changing a trained model's feature set requires retraining and fresh evaluation; old artifacts are rejected at inference if their feature names are outside this contract.
